name: blea
description: Agent-first BLE diagnostics, evidence replay, and guarded automation.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose and automate Bluetooth Low Energy devices.
interface.longDescription: BLEA gives agents a safe local BLE workflow: diagnose the adapter, inspect GATT services, capture and compare portable evidence, replay behavior without hardware, and perform explicitly authorized writes.
defaultPrompt: Diagnose my Bluetooth adapter and scan for nearby BLE devices.
Capture and compare two read-only BLE evidence packages.
Replay a BLE evidence package without connecting to hardware.
